serverInfo.name: KaiCalls
serverInfo.description: AI-powered phone answering service for businesses. Handles inbound calls, outbound campaigns, lead intake, appointment scheduling, and after-hours management.

auth.description: OAuth 2.1 (authorization code + PKCE S256, refresh tokens, DCR). A KaiCalls API key (kc_live_*) is also accepted via Authorization Bearer or X-KaiCalls-API-Key for direct API clients and MCP gateways.

surfaces.name: account
surfaces.description: The full operator inventory — calls, leads, voicemail, SMS, campaigns, analytics, agent config, evals, config history and billing for a business the caller already belongs to.

surfaces.name: acquisition
surfaces.audience: First-time buyers who do not have an account yet.
surfaces.description: A strict subset of the account surface: only the tools that take someone from "I keep missing calls" to a working business number that answers. Prefer this endpoint when helping someone set up a new phone line — it is the same authority, narrowed to the setup job, so a routing model is not choosing one tool out of fifty-one.

job.intent: Read back what this business is and what it already has set up.
Hear and pick the voice that answers the phone.
Create the secretary that will answer calls.
Find a phone number in the right area code.
Buy that number (spend is confirmed by a human, never assumed).
Route the number to the secretary.
Get the owner's own mobile number so Kai can ring it first and confirm forwarding.
Turn the number into a hosted phone system: the team rings first, Kai answers as an extension, and the office line forwards in.
Report the working number back and what happens next.

tools.name: retry_setup
tools.title: Reconcile Existing Setup
tools.description: Reconcile database pointers for an existing imported signup phone reservation. Owner-only, entitlement-checked, single-flight and idempotent. Never creates agents, buys numbers, changes provider routing or sends messages. PBX, missing imports, and stale claims return review blockers. Reuse the same key to read/replay the outcome; a failed request requires review before a new key. Ready means database agreement, not activation.

tools.name: get_setup_recovery_status
tools.title: Get Setup Recovery Status
tools.description: Read an owner-authorized setup recovery request by its business and idempotency key. Running requests are never automatically stolen, including stale requests. A ready receipt does not prove live activation.

tools.name: make_call
tools.title: Make Call
tools.description: Initiate an outbound voice preview via a KaiCalls AI agent. This lets the owner hear Kai, but it is preview only and never proves inbound routing or advances activation. Pass an idempotency_key to make the request safely retryable.

tools.name: check_call_status
tools.title: Check Call Status
tools.description: Check the status of a call by its ID

tools.name: list_recent_calls
tools.title: List Recent Calls
tools.description: List recent calls for the authenticated business

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.title: Get Transcript
tools.description: Get the transcript and summary of a completed call

tools.name: get_call_recording
tools.title: Get Call Recording
tools.description: Get the real call recording URL for a call so reviewers can listen to the voice/audio instead of relying only on the transcript.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.title: List Agents
tools.description: List the KaiCalls agents on the authenticated account. Use this before setting anything up, to see whether this business already has a secretary answering its calls.

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.title: Get Business Info
tools.description: Read back what a business already has: profile details, how many agents are configured, and recent call volume. Start here when someone wants a business number that answers missed calls, so nothing is created twice.

tools.name: get_operational_settings
tools.title: Get Operational Settings
tools.description: Audit the business-level operational setup required before changing a live account: staff alert recipients, SMS/email alert flags, escalation rules, textable send-link entries, and assigned agent voice/model/greeting metadata.

tools.name: configure_staff_alerts
tools.title: Configure Staff Alerts
tools.description: Save business-owned staff alert recipients and post-call escalation rules. Saving settings does not prove provider delivery or owner receipt; activation notification proof is tracked separately.

tools.name: get_activation_status
tools.title: Get Activation Status
tools.description: Read the persisted proof-first activation status for one accessible business. Returns masked evidence, the exact next action, and whether the command center/full MCP surface is unlocked. It cannot assert or advance proof. A number is not fully set up until the owner's own phone is on file (see owner_phone_on_file) and forwarding is verified — do not report the line as live/working on the strength of proof state alone.

owner_phone_on_file.description: Whether the owner's own mobile number is on file. False means no SMS nudge, ring-first, or forwarding verification can reach a human — the line is not fully set up regardless of proof state.

tools.name: confirm_notification_destination
tools.title: Confirm Activation Notification Destination
tools.description: APPROVAL-GATED. Save the owner-approved SMS or email destination for the exact active activation session. Delivery starts only when the inbound call artifact is ready, and settings alone never count as delivery proof.

tools.name: retry_activation_notification
tools.title: Retry Activation Notification
tools.description: APPROVAL-GATED. Retry only the current terminal or time-eligible activation notification channel for the exact active session. Requires a new idempotency key; ambiguous provider outcomes are never blindly resent.

tools.name: choose_customer_route
tools.title: Choose Customer Route
tools.description: APPROVAL-GATED. After setup proof is complete, save forwarding, published_number, both, or testing. This unlocks the command center but does not claim customer coverage; selected live routes remain pending until independently verified. A number is not fully set up until the owner's own phone is on file (see get_activation_status / set_owner_phone) and forwarding is verified.

tools.name: configure_textable_links
tools.title: Configure Textable Links
tools.description: Create or repair the business_links entries used by the send_link/send_sms tools. Use this when callers need booking, directions, cancellation, sister-location, or service-specific links texted without exposing raw URLs in the voice prompt.

tools.name: configure_agent_business_rules
tools.title: Configure Agent Business Rules
tools.description: Safely add or replace a named operational rules section inside an agent inbound prompt, then route the prompt patch through the governed agent.patch broker. Use this for cross-business handoffs, callback language, alert promises, and client-specific operating rules without round-tripping the whole prompt manually.

tools.name: list_leads
tools.title: List Leads
tools.description: List leads for the authenticated business, with optional status/source/agent filters. Includes the latest AI lead score when available.

tools.name: get_lead
tools.title: Get Lead
tools.description: Get full details for a single lead by ID, including the latest AI lead score and explanation.

tools.name: list_voicemails
tools.title: List Voicemails
tools.description: List recent voicemails for the authenticated business, including transcripts and recording URLs.

tools.name: list_sms_messages
tools.title: List SMS Messages
tools.description: List recent SMS messages for the authenticated business. Filter by conversation or direction (inbound/outbound).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.title: List Campaigns
tools.description: List outbound call campaigns for the authenticated business.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.title: Create Campaign
tools.description: Create an outbound call campaign (cadence + lead batch) and optionally launch it immediately. Launching queues calls for the orchestrator; existing TCPA/consent gating still applies at dial time. Requires admin role on the business.

tools.name: list_workflow_templates
tools.title: List Workflow Templates
tools.description: List the cadence/campaign workflow templates KaiCalls can run (standard, aggressive, nurture, custom), including each template's retry interval, defaults (call windows, days, attempts), and a ready-to-use cadence_config example. Call this before create_campaign so an external agent can trigger a multi-step sequence with launch=true instead of guessing the cadence_config shape blind. Static catalog — no per-business state.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.title: Get Analytics
tools.description: Get a dashboard summary (lead counts by status, conversion rate, call volume and duration, top agents, and business outcomes by type) over a recent time window.

tools.name: upsert_lead
tools.title: Create or Update Lead
tools.description: Create a new lead or update existing leads for the authenticated business, routed through the governed leads API (business access-checked, usage-logged, and audited). To create one, pass `lead` with at least one of name/phone/email plus optional status/source/notes/agent_id/etc. To update, pass `updates`: an array of { id, ...fields } for one or many existing leads (status, name, phone, email, notes, address, city, state, zip). Updates are access-checked per row and report partial success.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: Send an outbound text message from one of your agents' phone lines to a recipient, routed through the governed messaging API. Compliance gates (opt-out / Do-Not-Call / quiet-hours), rate limits, and message logging all apply. Provide from_agent_id (the sending agent), to (recipient phone in E.164), and message. Optionally link lead_id to attribute the text and respect that lead's automation-pause state.

tools.name: update_agent_config
tools.title: Update Agent Configuration
tools.description: Edit an agent's live runtime configuration — greeting/first message, inbound or SMS prompt, voice, language model, max call duration, and call-transfer settings — routed through the governed update broker so every change keeps the consent + audit trail (a versioned config snapshot and change history). Every write here is reversible: inspect what changed with get_change_history or list_config_versions, then undo it with rollback_config. Mutating changes need an idempotency_key; high-impact live changes need human authority (an authority envelope) or queue_for_approval for dashboard sign-off. For just a single named operational-rules section, prefer configure_agent_business_rules.

tools.name: request_kaicalls_update
tools.title: Request KaiCalls Update
tools.description: Ask the KaiCalls on-behalf update broker to perform a scoped, governed mutation. Supported intents: phone.emergency_address.set, transcripts.sink.configure, agent.patch, numbers.purchase, agent.config.rollback. Prefer update_agent_config for prompt/voice/model edits, configure_agent_business_rules for a single named operational prompt section, upsert_lead for lead create/update, send_sms for outbound texts, configure_staff_alerts for alert recipients/rules, and configure_textable_links for send-link setup. Mutating requests need an idempotency_key; high-risk changes need human authority. The broker returns needs_user_input, needs_approval, pending_approval, executed, denied, or unsupported — never an unaudited side effect.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.title: Get API Usage
tools.description: List recent API usage events (endpoint, method, status code, cost) for the caller's account. Mirrors GET /api/v1/usage.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.title: Get Balance
tools.description: Get per-business minutes-used and subscription status across every business the caller can access. Mirrors GET /api/v1/balance.

tools.name: list_numbers
tools.title: List Phone Numbers
tools.description: List phone numbers assigned to the accessible business(es), with capability and compliance flags. Assignment does not prove inbound routing, activation, or customer coverage — and a number is not fully set up until the owner's own phone is on file (see get_activation_status / set_owner_phone) and forwarding is verified. Mirrors GET /api/v1/numbers.

tools.name: get_phone_flow
tools.title: Get Phone Flow
tools.description: Read how calls ring on the business's hosted phone system: which cells and desk phones ring, for how many seconds, and whether after-hours callers go straight to the AI receptionist. Reconciled from the phone system on every call. Mirrors POST /api/v1/phone-system action=get_flow. Returns 409 when the hosted phone system is not set up for this business.

tools.name: update_phone_flow
tools.title: Update Phone Flow
tools.description: Replace how calls ring on the business's hosted phone system with a full phone flow: { version: 1, hours: { mode: 'always' | 'business_hours', afterHours: 'kai' }, ring: { members: [{ kind: 'cell', phone: E.164, label, requirePressOne } | { kind: 'desk_phone' | 'user', userId, label }], timeoutSeconds: 5-120 }, overflow: 'kai' }. Applied idempotently (only real differences are written); every member passes the forwarding-loop guard; business_hours mode derives the schedule from the business hours already on file. Read the current flow with get_phone_flow first and send it back with your edits. Mirrors POST /api/v1/phone-system action=save_flow.

tools.name: set_up_phone_system
tools.title: Set Up Phone System
tools.description: Turn the business's number into a hosted phone system: Kai is installed as extension 700, the owner's mobile joins a team ring group, and a dial plan rings the team first and hands the call to Kai when nobody picks up. Idempotent and resumable — a re-run reuses everything already created and reports it under `reused`. Needs a complete US street address on file (the emergency-services and tax location) and the owner's mobile: when either is missing the tool fails with `code` missing_address or missing_owner_mobile plus `required_field` and `next_action` saying exactly what to collect — pass it back as business_address or owner_mobile. Returns the status shape (extension, ring group, dial plan ids, the phone-system line) and `next_step`, the one line to relay to the owner (forward your line here / dial 700 from any office phone). Mirrors POST /api/v1/phone-system action=provision.

line.description: The phone-system line (E.164), if a number is attached.

next_step.description: The one line to relay to the owner.

required_field.description: Present when setup is blocked on a missing input.

next_action.description: What to collect and how to retry, when blocked.

tools.name: get_phone_system_status
tools.title: Get Phone System Status
tools.description: Read whether the business's hosted phone system is set up: Kai's extension, the team ring group and dial plan ids (never secrets), the phone-system line, and `next_step` — the one line to relay to the owner. Use it to confirm a set_up_phone_system run or before adding team phones. Mirrors GET /api/v1/phone-system.

tools.name: add_team_phone
tools.title: Add Team Phone
tools.description: Add a teammate's (or the owner's) cell to the phone system's team ring group so it rings before Kai answers. Idempotent — a cell already in the group reports ring_group already_member. Owners and admins are also registered on the admin roster, so calling the business line from that cell reaches the admin secretary; a member only rings. The business's own forwarded-from office line is refused (forwarding_loop) because ringing it would bounce the call straight back. Requires the phone system to be set up first (set_up_phone_system). Mirrors POST /api/v1/phone-system action=add_ring_group_member.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.title: List SMS Conversations
tools.description: List SMS conversation threads (counterparty timeline metadata) for the authenticated business, most recent first. Mirrors GET /api/v1/sms/conversations.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.title: Get SMS Conversation
tools.description: Get a single SMS conversation thread by ID. Mirrors GET /api/v1/sms/conversations?id=.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.title: Get Webhook Configuration
tools.description: List the configured outbound webhook(s) for a business, including supported event types. Mirrors GET /api/v1/webhooks.

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.title: Set Webhook
tools.description: Create or update a business outbound webhook (URL + subscribed events). Returns a webhook secret on first creation only. Mirrors POST /api/v1/webhooks.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.title: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Remove a business outbound webhook by ID. Mirrors DELETE /api/v1/webhooks.

tools.name: list_evals
tools.title: List Agent Evals
tools.description: List canned mock-conversation eval scenarios for an agent (or all accessible agents). Mirrors GET /api/v1/evals.

tools.name: run_eval
tools.title: Run Agent Eval
tools.description: Run a single eval scenario (eval_id) or every scenario for an agent (agent_id) against its live Vapi assistant and grade the result. Bills Vapi compute. Mirrors POST /api/v1/evals/run.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.title: List Voice Catalog
tools.description: List the curated, credential-free voice catalog (id, display name, accent, language, gender, sample URL) used to configure agent voices. Mirrors GET /api/v1/voices.

tools.name: create_agent
tools.title: Create Agent
tools.description: Create a new KaiCalls agent — the secretary that answers this business’s calls (Vapi assistant + KaiCalls records) — with a system prompt, greeting, voice, and model. Mirrors POST /api/v1/agents. Every subsequent mutation to this agent is versioned (assistant_config_versions) and reversible via rollback_config — inspect history with get_change_history / list_config_versions. Compliance: KaiCalls automatically applies state-aware AI-disclosure and consent handling to every agent it provisions, and flags high-risk business categories for extra review.

tools.name: attach_number
tools.title: Attach Phone Number
tools.description: Assign a phone number already in the KaiCalls registry pool to a business (and optionally route it directly to an agent). Does NOT purchase a new number — use search_available_numbers + buy_number for that. Mirrors POST /api/v1/phone-numbers.

tools.name: set_owner_phone
tools.title: Set Owner Phone
tools.description: Save the owner's own mobile number on the business record so Kai can ring it first and so activation/forwarding follow-ups can reach a human. A number is not fully set up until this is on file and forwarding is verified — connecting the number alone does not prove the owner can be reached. US numbers only; the number is normalized to E.164 and rejected if it cannot be validated as a US mobile/landline number. When ring_first is true (default), also configures ring-first routing so calls hit this cell before overflowing to the secretary — the same path used at signup.

tools.name: detach_number
tools.title: Detach Phone Number
tools.description: Release a phone number from a business back to the unassigned registry pool. Mirrors DELETE /api/v1/phone-numbers.

tools.name: search_available_numbers
tools.title: Search Available Numbers
tools.description: Search the carrier for phone numbers available to purchase (real-time Twilio inventory lookup). Mirrors GET /api/v1/phone-numbers/search.

tools.name: buy_number
tools.title: Buy Phone Number
tools.description: Request a real phone-number purchase. This is APPROVAL-GATED: the carrier bills immediately on execution, so the tool only prepares a request for authenticated owner review. Caller-supplied human_confirmed, dashboard_session, or system_policy fields never authorize execution. Relay the stored request and review URL to the owner; do not claim a number was purchased while approval is pending. Existing entitlement and carrier reservation checks still apply. Mirrors POST /api/v1/phone-numbers/purchase via numbers.purchase.

result.description: On executed: { number, vapi_registered, agent_attached, compliance: { high_risk_category, disclosure_note } }.

tools.name: list_knowledge
tools.title: List Agent Knowledge
tools.description: List agent knowledge base entries for a business. Mirrors GET /api/v1/knowledge.

tools.name: upsert_knowledge
tools.title: Create or Update Agent Knowledge
tools.description: Create a new agent knowledge base entry, or update one when `id` is provided. Mirrors POST /api/v1/knowledge. Creating requires title, content, and content_type.

tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List Agent Products
tools.description: List a business's agent product catalog. Mirrors GET /api/v1/products.

tools.name: upsert_product
tools.title: Create or Update Agent Product
tools.description: Create a new product row, or update one when `id` is provided. Mirrors POST /api/v1/products. Creating requires name and business_id. Pass `quantity` to set/update inventory.

tools.name: list_config_versions
tools.title: List Agent Config Versions
tools.description: List an agent's hashed, redacted assistant config version history (rollback lineage included). Pass `version` to fetch one version's full redacted config_snapshot instead of the list. Mirrors GET /api/v1/agents/versions.

tools.name: get_change_history
tools.title: Get Agent Change History
tools.description: List an agent's recent config-change audit trail (change_type, change_source, old/new value, timestamp) from admin_change_history — the same record the admin_get_change_history voice tool reads over the phone. Every mutation KaiCalls makes to an agent (via update_agent_config, configure_agent_business_rules, the admin call-in secretary, or the dashboard) is logged here and reversible with rollback_config.

tools.name: rollback_config
tools.title: Rollback Agent Configuration
tools.description: Request a rollback to a prior assistant_config_versions snapshot. This changes live greeting, voice, prompt and model settings, so authenticated owner review of the exact stored request is required. Caller-supplied authority fields never authorize execution. Discover a target with list_config_versions or get_change_history; relay the pending request's review URL. The agent.config.rollback executor preserves version recording and secret exclusion after trusted approval.

result.description: On executed: { agent_id, restored_from_version, restored_fields, skipped_fields, new_version_number, warning? }.

tools.name: list_observability_events
tools.title: List Observability Events
tools.description: List a business-scoped timeline of compact call-runtime events and redacted integration-delivery attempts. Mirrors GET /api/v1/observability-events and uses bounded keyset pagination.

tools.name: list_tool_execution_logs
tools.title: List Tool Execution Logs
tools.description: List per-call Vapi tool execution traces from vapi_tool_execution_logs — outcome, latency, timeout, and a redacted result preview for each routed tool call. Mirrors GET /api/v1/tool-execution-logs. Answers "did this tool call actually work".

tools.name: list_subscription_history
tools.title: List Subscription Change History
tools.description: List plan/price change history from subscription_change_history — the billing analogue of admin_change_history, written from the Stripe webhook and the right-size apply job. Mirrors GET /api/v1/subscription-history.

tools.name: list_overage_charges
tools.title: List Overage Charges
tools.description: List the idempotent overage-minutes ledger from billing_overage_charges (legacy per-minute-overage tiers only — 2026 plans carry no overage). GET /v1/balance/get_balance only returns an aggregate; this returns the underlying per-period ledger rows. Mirrors GET /api/v1/overage-charges.

tools.name: list_rightsize_recommendations
tools.title: List Plan Right-Size Recommendations
tools.description: List per-period auto-right-size decisions from plan_rightsize_recommendations, including the dry_run -> notified -> (kept | applied | superseded) lifecycle. Answers "is this business about to get right-sized". Mirrors GET /api/v1/rightsize-recommendations.

tools.name: report_issue
tools.title: Report an Issue
tools.description: Report a problem with your KaiCalls agent, phone number, billing, or account. Saves the report to your change history and notifies KaiCalls support so a person can follow up — use this any time something is broken or not working as expected.
